limitations: No Verilator was run. Spike validates exact execution and ordering, not a hardware overlap speedup.
Instruction windows are experiment-only instrumentation; pure constant setup can move outside CSR windows. Both builds use the same instrumentation.
The measured change includes requant-A and tile pipelining; whole-model/FireSim cycles are not claimed.
Retained-source host readouts owned by Merlin remain at their existing ABI boundary; the parallel Merlin implementation uses the documented contract.
Dependency/layout/refusal cases retain serial execution; an invalid fast constant certificate is rejected and an unproved affine candidate uses the exact threshold table.
negative_evidence: The older phase_a_device helper assumes capture-bundle assets for every case; the frozen _to_copy shard has no such directory. The complete 193-case rebuild and all 38 support cases were instead graded through their original prepared bundle/reference records.
The independent checker omits unprivileged counter extensions; the bare-metal test harness now reads machine-mode mcycle, allowing the full overlap ELF audit to complete.
Historical requantization receipts remain unchanged; the previous reciprocal/remainder implementation is removed from the production compiler.
